goal.ar: فهم النتائج: التأثير الدوائي الضار طبيعي وسمية الدواء غير طبيعي.

segments.en: Karim is a patient at the clinic.
segments.fr: Karim est un·e patient·e à la clinique.

segments.en: Today, the doctor has the results.

segments.en: Lina, a medical student, listens.
segments.fr: Lina, étudiant·e en médecine, écoute.

segments.en: The doctor says, “The adverse drug reaction is normal.”
segments.fr: Le médecin dit : « Effet indésirable médicamenteux (EIM) est normal(e). »

segments.en: “But the drug toxicity is not normal.”
segments.fr: « Mais Toxicité médicamenteuse n'est pas normal(e). »

segments.en: Lina asks, “Is the drug toxicity normal?”
segments.fr: Lina demande : « Toxicité médicamenteuse est-il/elle normal(e) ? »

segments.en: The doctor says, “No, it is not.”
segments.fr: Le médecin répond : « Non. »

questions.q: Is the adverse drug reaction normal?
accepted: the adverse drug reaction is normal
questions.model: Yes, the adverse drug reaction is normal.

questions.q: Is the drug toxicity normal?
accepted: the drug toxicity is not normal
questions.model: No, the drug toxicity is not normal.

hint.en: Careful: the drug toxicity is NOT normal.
hint.fr: Attention : Toxicité médicamenteuse n'est PAS normal(e).

questions.q: Which one is not normal: the adverse drug reaction or the drug toxicity?

questions.model: The drug toxicity is not normal.

questions.q: Who has the results?

questions.q: Who listens to the doctor?
questions.model: Lina listens to the doctor.
